tools.description: utilpeek: GPU prices: cheapest H100, A100, L4 per GPU-hour on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Akash. Returns cheapest GPU prices per GPU-hour on AWS, Azure and Google Cloud (list prices) and Akash (marketplace bids with GPUs free), by chip, memory, minimum GPUs per cloud machine, region and price ceiling;
